children: MaxCyte reported preliminary third-quarter 2026 revenue driven by approximately $8.1 million of core business revenue and more than $1.0 million of Strategic Platform License (SPL) Program-related revenue, including a $1.0 million milestone. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to approximately $34 million, up from prior guidance of $30–$32 million. MaxCyte will release full financial results and host an earnings call on November 10, 2026.
Preliminary Q3 2026 core business revenue: approximately $8.1 million (up 26% vs. Q3 2025).
Preliminary Q3 2026 SPL Program-related revenue: more than $1.0 million, including a $1.0 million milestone recognized in the quarter.
Updated full-year 2026 total revenue guidance: approximately $34 million (previous guidance $30–$32 million).
Updated full-year 2026 core business revenue guidance: approximately $28 million (previous guidance $25–$27 million).
Updated full-year 2026 SPL Program-related revenue guidance: approximately $6 million, including about $4 million from milestone payments and approximately $2 million from commercial royalties.
Second-half 2026 core business revenue is tracking to roughly 15% year-over-year growth, with strong outperformance in Q3 driven by accelerated instrument purchases from a large customer.
Recognition of a second SPL milestone in 2026 reflects advancing activity under SPL partnerships and contributes to raised SPL revenue guidance.
MaxCyte is supporting more late-stage clinical programs under SPL partnerships than previously, including two pivotal trials with potential regulatory approval as early as next year.

Company emphasizes focus on executing strategic priorities to strengthen its position as an enabling technology partner in cell and gene therapy and to build a foundation for sustainable long-term growth.
